headline: MLB preparing for possible MLBPA disclaimer of interest
summary: Citing the WSJ, notes owners have readied for the union ending its bargaining role during a lockout; a deal before Dec. 1 is seen as very unlikely.

headline: MLB offers to push the salary cap start back to 2028
summary: Owners proposed a $258.2M cap and $180.2M floor with 2027 rules unchanged; the union called it a non-starter and no talks are scheduled.

headline: Bednar, Suzuki, Arozarena among eight players to receive qualifying offers
summary: Eight free agents got $23.15M offers with an Nov. 17 decision deadline, as a lockout is expected after Dec. 1.

headline: 2027 season threatened as the labor deal nears its Dec. 1 end
summary: Recaps both proposals, notes 144 new free agents and a possible spending rush before an expected lockout.

headline: How baseball got to the brink of a lockout
summary: A primer on the owners' cap push, the union's revenue-sharing asks and what stands in the way of a normal 2027.

headline: The money behind the owners' willingness to risk a lockout
summary: Bankers see a cap as a way to close the franchise value gap with the NFL and NBA, even at the cost of games.

headline: Every key offseason date before the expected lockout
summary: Walks the calendar from option deadlines to Opening Day and where a lockout starts to bite.

headline: Why the coming lockout puts the sport's structure on the table
summary: Covers MLB's seven-year proposal, local media centralization and the Olympics side track.
